 Summary
 Brighton lead Man City through first-half Ayari opener
 Coventry lead Sunderland 3-1, Hull, Brentford and Bournemouth in front
 Man Utd on longest winless run for 38 years after defeat by Chelsea - report 
 Sent-off Martinez scores 3/10 - Chelsea v Man Utd ratings

 Most recent Most popular Post published at 16:32 GMT 16:32 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 Junior Kroupi shows his tidy feet to skip past the challenge and tee up Tyler Adams. 
 The former Leeds man fancies a goal against his old club but his effort is a bit of a daisy cutter.

 More changes for the visitors.

 Testing times for Maresca published at 16:30 GMT 16:30 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Shamoon Hafez 
Football reporter at Etihad Stadium 
 Twenty minutes for Manchester City to turn this one around, they have been left frustrated so far.
 It will be back-to-back league defeats if they lose here. They failed to complete the job inside 90 minutes on Wednesday too.
 Testing times for manager Enzo Maresca.

 get involved Get Involved published at 16:28 GMT 16:28 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Three shots in an hour of football is simply not good enough from Leeds. Coupled with the howler of the season and the promising start has turned into a long winless run.

 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Chris Sutton 
Former Blackburn striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 While Man City are doing all the attacking, you do wonder whether Brighton could pick them off on the counter-attack.

 Post published at 16:28 GMT 16:28 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Bart Verbruggen has made five saves in this match.
 The latest a superb one to deny Matheus Nunes.

 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 And now the Cherries look to their bench as Justin Kluivert replaces Junior Kroupi. 
 36 25 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Hull City 2-1 Ipswich Town published at 16:28 GMT 16:28 GMT 
 Oliver McBurnie (Hull City) 
 That free-kick always looked a great chance for Hull City and Oliver McBurnie steps up and drives a low curler into the net.
 Christian Walton got a hand to it, but couldn't keep it out. Hull have had two shots on target and less than 35% of possession, but they lead. Ipswich have fallen apart.
 330 211 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 16:27 GMT 16:27 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 Ooooh, inches away from Rayan. 
 The ball is bouncing around the box and it drops to the Brazilian but he lashes it just wide. 
 James Trafford was getting nowhere near it. 
 64 75 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:27 GMT 16:27 GMT 
 Brentford 1-0 Nottm Forest 
 Oliver Glasner is looking animated on the touchline. 
 At this point last season, Nottingham Forest had already sacked two of their managers.
 He must be feeling the pressure with his side sitting deep in the relegation zone as things stand.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 41 30 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:27 GMT 16:27 GMT 
 Hull City 1-1 Ipswich Town 
 Mohamed Belloumi is fouled and Hull City have a free-kick, central, just outside the penalty area. A real chance to go ahead.
 32 18 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Coventry need to stick together' published at 16:26 GMT 16:26 GMT 
 Coventry 3-1 Sunderland 
 Ellen White 
Former England striker on Final Score 
 There's 25 minutes left and anything can happen. Sunderland have made some changes. 
 Enzo Le Fee's goal should give them some momentum now. Coventry need to stick together, they can't lose this now.
 133 49 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTIONS published at 16:26 GMT 16:26 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 Daniel Farke has seen enough as Sean Longstaff, Lukas Nmecha and Anton Stach replace Dan James, Gabriel Gudmundsson and Ao Tanaka.

 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Chris Sutton 
Former Blackburn striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Jaouen Hadjam has a big job in that left-back position. Olivier Boscagli struggled to contain Iliman Ndiaye.

 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Some changes to report.
 For City, Enzo Fernandez is replaced by Nico O'Reilly.
 For Brighton, Mats Wieffer and Jaouen Hadjam are on for Chema Andres and Olivier Boscagli.

 CLOSE! published at 16:25 GMT 16:25 GMT 
 Hull City 1-1 Ipswich Town 
 Ipswich only half-clear a ball into the box and Lewie Coyle strikes it hard and low at goal. With goalkeeper Christian Walton not moving, the ball zips wide of the far post.
